blocks.html: In a special series of shows, Zsa Zsa Padilla, will be performing at Robinsons Malls to give holiday cheer to shoppers this December. Richard Yap, best known for his role as Sir Chief on a daytime TV drama, is joining the songstress as her special guest. Show date are as follows: December 2, Saturday, Robinsons Place Manila, December 8, Friday, Robinsons Galleria Cebu and December 10, Sunday, Robinsons Magnolia. ZSA ZSA PADILLA Zsa Zsa rose to fame in the 1980s, first as part of a show band, before embarking on a solo career that propelled her to hit maker status. In a few years, she was performing in sold-out concerts, and dabbling in movie acting and TV hosting. Today, she is known as the Divine Diva, who reigns supreme onstage while belting out the most heart-wrenching ballads or the latest upbeat tunes. RICHARD YAP On top of being a dashing and debonair leading man on TV, Richard Yap is also a recording artist and concert performer. As much as audiences await his next role on the big and small screens, so do they take delight in watching the chinito crooner perform his signature songs from his TV hit series, and more. Don’t fail to watch Zsa Zsa Padilla, with her special guest Richard Yap this December!
